The Router correctly identified the failure of the 'Tranquil/Natural' checkpoint due to the sky object. The 'Wet soil' checkpoint failure is also correctly identified; the ground looks uniformly dry and dusty, lacking the specific hydrological signature of a lakeshore.

The lack of reflections is a subtle physical artifact that compounds the structural issues.

Only 4/9 checkpoints passed. The failures in 'Reflections', 'Wet Soil', and 'Natural Vegetation' indicate a superficial understanding of the class physics and biology by the generator. The alignment is low because the core 'natural' aspect of the class is violated by the hallucination.
